jingchai-ji.zh: 江边送别：十朋将赴京城，玉莲难舍难分。
jingchai-ji.en: River farewell: Shipeng leaves for the capital; Yulian can hardly let go.

jingchai-ji.zh: 叮嘱深情：玉莲诉说恩义，荆钗为聘记在心。
jingchai-ji.en: Parting counsel: Yulian speaks of devotion; the thorn hairpin seals their bond.

jingchai-ji.zh: 赴考之志：盼蟾宫折桂，又愁仕途风波。
jingchai-ji.en: Exam ambitions: hope for success, fear of the official world’s storms.

jingchai-ji.zh: 遥望青云：情系荆钗，未别先问归期。
jingchai-ji.en: Eyes on the clouds: love tied to the pin; asking when he will return.

jingchai-ji.zh: 双喜临门：才子佳人、金榜题名的喜庆场面。
jingchai-ji.en: Double joy: scholar and beauty, exam success celebrated.

jingchai-ji.zh: 回望贫贱：钱氏女与荆钗聘礼的前尘旧事。
jingchai-ji.en: Looking back on hard days: the Qian daughter and the thorn-pin betrothal.

baitu-ji.zh: 寒夜凄清：风月萧索，身世飘零的开场氛围。
baitu-ji.en: Cold night opening: bleak wind and moon, a life adrift.

baitu-ji.zh: 患难奔波：白兔记中的流离与求生。
baitu-ji.en: Hardship on the road: exile and survival in Baitu Ji.

baitu-ji.zh: 团聚与辨认：亲情线逐步收束。
baitu-ji.en: Recognition and reunion: family threads draw together.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.zh: 十八相送起程：梁山伯送祝英台上路，依依不舍。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.en: Eighteen-li farewell begins: Liang escorts Zhu; reluctance to part.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.zh: 一路托物：借景、借物暗示深情，不便直说。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.en: Coded affection on the road: scenery and objects stand in for what cannot be said aloud.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.zh: 惜别将尽：相送将近终点，情意更浓、归期未卜。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.en: Near the end of the send-off: feeling deepens; return still uncertain.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.zh: 十八相送起程：梁祝惜别，刚上路。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.en: Eighteen-li farewell begins: Liang and Zhu set out.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.zh: 托景言情：沿途景物暗藏心意。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.en: Feeling through landscape: roadside scenes carry coded affection.

liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.zh: 相送将尽：离别在即，余情未了。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong-full.en: Send-off nearly done: parting near, feeling unfinished.

xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.zh: 心酸开场：祥林嫂缓缓开口，身世苦难将倾诉。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.en: Bitter opening: Xianglin Sao begins; suffering is about to be told.

xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.zh: 诉苦中段：丧子、冷遇与命运不公层层叠加。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.en: Mid account: loss, cold treatment, and unjust fate pile up.

xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.zh: 悲愤收束：控诉与叹息交织，情绪更沉。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.en: Grief closes in: accusation and sighing; the tone grows heavier.

liangzhu-xia.zh: 梁祝下卷：情事急转，悲剧气氛渐浓。
liangzhu-xia.en: Later Butterfly Lovers: the story turns; tragedy gathers.

liangzhu-xia.zh: 化蝶前夕：诀别与不舍层层叠加。
liangzhu-xia.en: Before metamorphosis: farewell and reluctance pile up.

liangzhu-xia.zh: 收束：传说收尾，余韵未尽。

mudanting-huanhunji.zh: 还魂起：丽娘情思萌动，梦境与花园交织。
mudanting-huanhunji.en: Return begins: Liniang’s longing; dream and garden intertwine.

mudanting-huanhunji.zh: 寻梦与伤逝：生死相隔，情未断。
mudanting-huanhunji.en: Dream-seeking and mourning: life and death apart; love unbroken.

mudanting-huanhunji.zh: 还魂团圆线：梦梅与丽娘终得相认。
mudanting-huanhunji.en: Return and reunion: Mengmei and Liniang find each other.

chen-sanliang.zh: 陈三两开场：沉冤未雪，性情刚烈。
chen-sanliang.en: Chen Sanliang opens: injustice unmet; fierce temperament.

chen-sanliang.zh: 辩诬中段：据理力争，声情俱烈。
chen-sanliang.en: Mid defense: arguing with heat and clarity.

chen-sanliang.zh: 收束：是非渐明，余怒未平。
chen-sanliang.en: Close: truth clears; anger not fully spent.

zanghua-yin.zh: 葬花起：落花流水，伤春自怜。
zanghua-yin.en: Burial begins: fallen blossoms; spring grief.

zanghua-yin.zh: 吟花中段：花与人同命，愁绪更深。
zanghua-yin.en: Mid lament: flower and self share one fate.

zanghua-yin.zh: 收束：葬花已尽，余悲未消。

chai-tou-feng.zh: 钗头凤：旧情重逢，满腹酸楚。
chai-tou-feng.en: Chai Tou Feng: old love meets again; bitterness fills the air.

chai-tou-feng.zh: 诀别之痛：错负与无奈交织。
chai-tou-feng.en: Parting pain: regret and helplessness intertwine.

limaohuan-taizi.zh: 狸猫换太子：宫廷阴谋与母子失散。
limaohuan-taizi.en: Civet-cat swap: court intrigue; mother and child parted.

limaohuan-taizi.zh: 辨认与奔波：真相一线，风险未除。
limaohuan-taizi.en: Recognition on the road: truth near; danger remains.

limaohuan-taizi.zh: 收束：冤案将雪，团圆可期。

hongloumeng-1.en: Red Chamber part 1: Bao-Dai and Jia-house affairs.

hongloumeng-1.zh: 中段唱词：人情冷暖与心事暗涌。

Mid: feeling pulled against court rules.

para-2.en: Opening settle: scene and ties not yet spelled out.

para-2.zh: 中段推进：冲突或情思加重。
para-2.en: Mid stretch: conflict or longing thickens.

para-2.zh: 后段收束：情绪落到收尾。
para-2.en: Closing stretch: feeling lands toward the end.

para-3.en: Opening settle: the scene locks first.

para-3.zh: 中段推进：对白与唱夹杂。
para-3.en: Mid stretch: speech and song interleave.

para-3.zh: 后段收束：冲突或抒情到顶。
para-3.en: Closing stretch: conflict or lyric peaks.

biyu-zan-xinfang.zh: 开场冷清：新房空寂，气氛先立住。
biyu-zan-xinfang.en: Cold open: empty bridal chamber; the mood settles first.

biyu-zan-xinfang.zh: 孤影自叹：红烛照影，李秀英自道身世委屈。
biyu-zan-xinfang.en: Lone shadow: candles on her face; Li Xiuying names her grievance.

biyu-zan-xinfang.zh: 碧玉簪祸端：误拿玉簪，招来闲是非。
biyu-zan-xinfang.en: Jade-pin trouble: a misplaced pin invites idle blame.

biyu-zan-xinfang.zh: 夫君心疑：一夜冷落，难捱到天明。
biyu-zan-xinfang.en: Husband’s doubt: cold neglect through a sleepless night.

biyu-zan-xinfang.zh: 泪湿五更：愁绪难眠，收束到哽咽。
biyu-zan-xinfang.en: Tears toward dawn: sleepless sorrow closes the aria.

he-wenxiu-suanming.zh: 算命上门：何文秀开场自报，请大娘听端详。
he-wenxiu-suanming.en: Seer at the door: He Wenxiu introduces himself to the dame.

he-wenxiu-suanming.zh: 走方问疑：自称算命走四方，愿听疑难。
he-wenxiu-suanming.en: Itinerant offer: he walks the roads and invites her trouble.

he-wenxiu-suanming.zh: 细商量：先生邀对方把事说开。
he-wenxiu-suanming.en: Talk it through: he asks her to lay the matter out.

he-wenxiu-suanming.zh: 大娘报八字：家中费疑难，求先生细看。
he-wenxiu-suanming.en: Dame reports the eight characters: household worry needs a reading.

he-wenxiu-suanming.zh: 掐指推算：何文秀细算，奥妙不一般。
he-wenxiu-suanming.en: Finger calculation: He Wenxiu works the numbers; mystery deepens.

hongloumeng-tianxia.zh: 初见将至：宝黛见面前的气息。
hongloumeng-tianxia.en: Before first sight: the air just ahead of Baoyu meeting Daiyu.

hongloumeng-tianxia.zh: 请教姐姐：宝玉口称姐姐，求多多指教。
hongloumeng-tianxia.en: Asking sister: Baoyu greets Daiyu and seeks her guidance.

hongloumeng-tianxia.zh: 灵芝草：怕冲撞了天上掉下的林妹妹。
hongloumeng-tianxia.en: Lingzhi grass: fear of startling the sister from heaven.

longmen-kezhai.zh: 开场刀光：客栈腥风已起，忠奸未明。
longmen-kezhai.en: Blade-light open: inn danger starts; loyalty still unclear.

longmen-kezhai.zh: 厂卫布迷阵：缉事运筹，暗线交错。
longmen-kezhai.en: Depot nets: Eastern Depot schemes; hidden lines cross.

longmen-kezhai.zh: 身份试探：盘查贼踪，寒暖话里藏锋。
longmen-kezhai.en: Identity probes: thief trails questioned; warmth hides edge.

longmen-kezhai.zh: 官道已封：东厂埋伏，逃亡压力陡升。
longmen-kezhai.en: Road sealed: ambush set; escape pressure spikes.

longmen-kezhai.zh: 亲情夹缝：婚嫁消息与逃命并置。
longmen-kezhai.en: Kinship under fire: marriage news beside flight.

longmen-kezhai.zh: 暗道脱身：淮安一线，跟走求生。
longmen-kezhai.en: Secret passage: Huai’an line; follow to survive.

longmen-kezhai.zh: 对峙收束：有眼看不见——冲突顶到尽头。
longmen-kezhai.en: Final clash: ‘eyes that do not see’—conflict peaks.

pearl-tower-gift.zh: 赠塔之前：表兄落魄，翠娥将以信物相赠。
pearl-tower-gift.en: Before the gift: cousin in hardship; Cui’e will offer the token.

pearl-tower-gift.zh: 嘱别珍重：珍珠塔相赠，望兄长一路珍重。
pearl-tower-gift.en: Farewell counsel: pearl tower gifted; take care on the road.

wunv-baishou-huashu.zh: 拜寿花树：同园氛围先立。
wunv-baishou-huashu.en: Birthday garden: shared orchard mood settles.

wunv-baishou-huashu.zh: 同门不同心：姐妹对照，人情冷暖一句点破。
wunv-baishou-huashu.en: Same gate, different hearts: one line exposes warmth and chill.

xixiangji-kaohong.zh: 拷红起声：老夫人唤红娘，盘问将起。
xixiangji-kaohong.en: Interrogation starts: Madame calls Hongniang; questioning begins.

xixiangji-kaohong.zh: 追问张生：神情恍惚，疑为小姐相思成疾。
xixiangji-kaohong.en: About Zhang Sheng: distracted looks; love-sickness suspected.

xixiangji-kaohong.zh: 逼问知情：同窗岂不知情，红娘须实说。
xixiangji-kaohong.en: Pressed for truth: as companion she must know—and speak.

xixiangji-kaohong.zh: 红娘实告：小姐与张生月下传书寄相思。
xixiangji-kaohong.en: Hongniang confesses: moonlight letters between the lovers.

xixiangji-kaohong.zh: 息怒从长：暂缓严惩，此事还望计议。
xixiangji-kaohong.en: Ease the anger: defer punishment; counsel further.

zhuiyu-guandeng.zh: 观灯将起：灯景铺垫，人情未明说。
zhuiyu-guandeng.en: Before lanterns: scenery laid; feeling not yet said.

zhuiyu-guandeng.zh: 夫妻观灯：双双把灯观，景物与人情并写。
zhuiyu-guandeng.en: Couple at the lanterns: scenery and feeling together.
